verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench, so turning a tracked issue into a pull request is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no issue-tracker integration and no pull request creation. The 'Goal' feature for planning, executing and verifying multi-step work is an adjacent capability. It does not cover ingesting an issue or opening a PR, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
